Recover the Past#000.dst: 到  跟 Picard 博士談話。

Recover the Past#001.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#001.dst: 成功了！成功、成功、成——功！我是天才，是世上最聰明的人！
Recover the Past#001.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#002.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#002.dst: 那邊那位，隨機的路人！你剛才見證了一項魔法奇蹟！我剛剛成功復原了自己多年以前的記憶！
Recover the Past#002.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#003.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#003.dst: 你看起來也是 Fruma 來的吧？那你跟我一樣清楚，你過去的人生記憶已經消失了。噗。沒了！
Recover the Past#003.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#004.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
Recover the Past#004.dst: 但有了這個裝置……我們可以改變這件事！把失去的東西找回來！復原那個——你懂我的意思。
Recover the Past#004.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#005.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#005.dst: 現在，我極度需要受試者……你當一個是不錯，不過我得更確定這東西真的有效。
Recover the Past#005.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#006.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#006.dst: 聽好了！我有個提議。你想把記憶拿回來吧？帶足夠的受試者來給我，我就讓你看看你失去了什麼！
Recover the Past#006.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#007.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#007.dst: 我看看、我看看……我們需要原本來自 Fruma 的人。這一帶有幾個。
Recover the Past#007.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#008.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#008.dst: 你可以先從那個自稱水手的 Caid 開始。他就在 {p} 過去一點——沿著路走到河邊就會看到他。
Recover the Past#008.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#009.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the Past#009.dst: 在那之前，我會在這裡繼續調整……它還不算完美。我自己還有很大一部分的記憶是空的……嗯？你怎麼還在這裡？快去啊！
Recover the Past#009.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#010.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at .
Recover the Past#010.dst: 到  的船邊找到水手 Caid。

Recover the Past#011.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#011.dst: 怎麼？我都把任務交給你了，你還待在這裡做什麼？去找那個水手 Caid。他就在 {p} 過去一點，沿著路走到河邊。
Recover the Past#011.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#012.src: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#012.dst: 啊？哦！我——呃，這裡沒什麼好看的！只是……只是在看看我這艘老船！
Recover the Past#012.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#013.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#013.dst: Picard 派你來的？那個窩在塔裡的傢伙？哦。真高興知道他總算把東西弄完了。可是他找我做什麼？
Recover the Past#013.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#014.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
Recover the Past#014.dst: ……看我在 Fruma 的記憶？這我可就不太確定了。既然那些記憶不見了，那一定有它不見的理由。我——我在這裡過得很好！用不著知道什麼……
Recover the Past#014.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#015.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#015.dst: ……好啦，行。我跟你去讓人檢查我的記憶。不過你得先幫我一個忙，行吧？
Recover the Past#015.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#016.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#016.dst: 我算是個會蓋東西的人。想說來試試造艘船，然後，就是這艘啦！挺不錯的吧？
Recover the Past#016.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#017.src: That's what I'm talking about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#017.dst: 這就對了嘛，Reynauld 你聽到沒！我就知道會有人喜歡！
Recover the Past#017.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#018.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#018.dst: 喂！嘿嘿，好吧，你說得也沒錯。這是我用四處撿來的廢料東拼西湊的。不過對一堆廢鐵來說，還挺像樣的吧？
Recover the Past#018.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#019.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#019.dst: 你得答應我不會跟 Reynauld 說……有些比較稀有的零件是從衛兵的營房來的。沒什麼大不了的！就是從上面撈個一點……
Recover the Past#019.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#020.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived from the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#020.dst: 我只差最後一個零件就完工了，然後，你看……鐵匠鋪剛好到了一批貨……你懂我的意思了吧？
Recover the Past#020.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#021.src: Get me the part from the blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#021.dst: 幫我從鐵匠鋪把那個零件弄來，我就跟你去 Picard 的塔。我總不能把我的寶貝就這樣丟著不完工吧？
Recover the Past#021.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#022.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at .
Recover the Past#022.dst: 從  的鐵匠家偷出那個箱子。

Recover the Past#023.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#023.dst: 箱子拿到了嗎？就在鐵匠那裡，離這裡不遠，在 {p} 裡面。記住，別被發現了！
Recover the Past#023.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#024.src: Bring the package to Caid at .
Recover the Past#024.dst: 把包裹帶到  給 Caid。

Recover the Past#025.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#025.dst: ……你回來了！怎麼樣？來，東西給我。
Recover the Past#025.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#026.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#026.dst: 鐵匠沒看到什麼吧？我有點擔心 Reynauld 已經盯上我了……
Recover the Past#026.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#027.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#027.dst: 啊，管他的！總算能把我這艘老船收尾了！
Recover the Past#027.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#028.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#028.dst: 搞定！鏘鏘！看起來怎麼樣？
Recover the Past#028.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#029.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#029.dst: 沒錯！像樣的船都得有一口鐘。少了它就不對味了。
Recover the Past#029.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#030.src: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#030.dst: 你那什麼態度！像樣的船都得有一口鐘，你知道吧？你以為渡船會沒有鐘嗎？我想也是！
Recover the Past#030.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#031.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#031.dst: 總之……我猜你那邊的條件是履行了，那我也只好履行我這邊的！
Recover the Past#031.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#032.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#032.dst: 帶路去 Picard 的塔吧！來看看我這顆大腦袋裡藏了什麼。
Recover the Past#032.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#033.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at .
Recover the Past#033.dst: 帶 Caid 到  的塔裡找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#035.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#035.dst: 啊哈！你們回來了！好、好，這正好可以測試我做的那些調整……
Recover the Past#035.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#036.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#036.dst: ……好喔。所以我們要把我的記憶交給這位博士？
Recover the Past#036.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#037.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#037.dst: 好了好了，別小看我的天才。你不會有事的！大概啦。我給它九成五——嗯，九成的成功率。來，站上來這裡。
Recover the Past#037.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#038.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#038.dst: 好吧……我相信您知道自己在做什麼，博士……
Recover the Past#038.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#039.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#039.dst: 接下來，我只要……在這裡啟動法術，按下那邊的開關，然後……
Recover the Past#039.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#041.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#041.dst: 好，來看看我們有什麼……Edwin，你能不能檢查一下那邊另一個板條箱？
Recover the Past#041.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#042.src: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#042.dst: 沒問題。欸 Caid。你到底是怎麼一直弄到這些東西的？裡面有些零件很貴，感覺不太是你買得起的價位。
Recover the Past#042.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#043.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#043.dst: 這個嘛……就說衛兵那批最新的補給包，比原本應該有的重量輕了一點點吧。
Recover the Past#043.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#044.src: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
Recover the Past#044.dst: 等等你說什麼？Caid，拜託告訴我你沒有在偷衛兵的東西。你知道他們不會——
Recover the Past#044.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#045.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#045.dst: Edwin，放輕鬆。我只是從他們的補給上面撈一點。三十包裡少個一兩包，他們不會發現的。
Recover the Past#045.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#046.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#046.dst: 再說了，我又不怕他們。他們不就是來保護我們的嗎？我看他們頂多口頭警告我一下，就像前面那幾次一樣。
Recover the Past#046.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#047.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#047.dst: 如果……你這麼說的話。我想你說得對。他們其實也用不著那麼多補給。而且我們比他們更懂得怎麼用！
Recover the Past#047.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#048.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
Recover the Past#048.dst: 就是這樣！很高興你同意。那麼，你有沒有找到什麼好——
Recover the Past#048.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#049.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#049.dst: 你們兩個！別動，你們被捕了！
Recover the Past#049.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#051.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
Recover the Past#051.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#052.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#052.dst: 你夠了。你們兩個，把同夥追出來。
Recover the Past#052.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#055.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#055.dst: Caid，你因多次竊取帝國財產遭到逮捕。
Recover the Past#055.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#056.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#056.dst: 你的紀錄顯示，你先前的行為已經收過多次警告。這是你最後一次機會，而你把它徹底浪費掉了。
Recover the Past#056.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#057.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#057.dst: 把他押到監獄進一步訊問，再決定該怎麼處置他。
Recover the Past#057.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#058.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#058.dst: 喂！哈囉？路人升格的助手！從你那個恍神狀態裡出來，我們得談談。
Recover the Past#058.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#059.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
Recover the Past#059.dst: 嗯。嗯嗯嗯。記憶在那裡斷掉了……我很好奇，要是我們能——
Recover the Past#059.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#061.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
Recover the Past#061.dst: 是的，看來是如此……不過也許，只要我能把功率提高，那麼……對了！我真是天——
Recover the Past#061.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#062.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#062.dst: 我就只是這樣？！一個賊……我就只配當這種東西？
Recover the Past#062.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#065.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#065.dst: 啊！路人升格的助——算了，我就直接叫你助手吧。我看你總算從恍神裡出來了。
Recover the Past#065.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#066.src: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
Recover the Past#066.dst: 不過那現在不重要了！重要的是我們剛才看到的東西！記憶以栩栩如生的細節重現！這個裝置真的會改變世界！
Recover the Past#066.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#067.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#067.dst: ……不過我得說。事情的時間順序讓我有點迷惑。Caid 被逮捕了——那他後來怎麼會出現在 Wynn，還當了士兵？
Recover the Past#067.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#068.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#068.dst: 要弄清楚真相，我們需要更多受試者！今天有一位偵察兵 Reynauld 在值勤，他原本也是 Fruma 人，跟你一樣。
Recover the Past#068.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#069.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#069.dst: 對，嗯。你會在通往 {p} 的橋附近找到他。我就靠你去說服他加入我們的實驗了。以科學之名！
Recover the Past#069.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#070.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at .
Recover the Past#070.dst: 到  通往 {p} 的橋附近找到偵察兵 Reynauld。

Recover the Past#071.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#071.dst: 嗯……這道屏障究竟在哪裡？是這個魔法還不夠強、突破不了嗎？也許我把功率再提高，那麼……
Recover the Past#071.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#072.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#072.dst: 啊！助手！你怎麼還在這裡？你跟偵察兵 Reynauld 談過了嗎？他就在通往 {p} 的橋附近。
Recover the Past#072.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#073.dst: 就……讓我一個人靜一靜，行嗎？
Recover the Past#073.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#074.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#074.dst: 啊，你好。有什麼事嗎？你看起來像是有事要找我。
Recover the Past#074.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#075.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
Recover the Past#075.dst: 嗯？那個奇怪的博士要見我？要復原我的記憶？我不能說我有多信任那個人……不過我確實好奇它到底管不管用。
Recover the Past#075.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#076.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#076.dst: 可惜我得婉拒。我不能讓崗位無人看守。萬一腐化物來襲怎麼辦？{p} 會毫無防備。
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#077.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#077.dst: 嗯，這樣啊。如果只是離開一小段時間，那或許可行。前提是你答應我，真的發生襲擊的時候你要幫忙。
Recover the Past#077.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#078.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#078.dst: 那就這麼說定了。我跟你去見那位博士。不過我們得先找個人來守著。你心裡有人選嗎？
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#079.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do. I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#079.dst: Caid？那個……小偷。他一直在偷補給，我知道。我就是拿不出證據。不過，如果你覺得他行的話。應該沒問題吧。
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#080.src: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#080.dst: 我不久前看到他往神殿那邊走。說不定他回心轉意了。你帶路去找 Caid，我跟在你後面。
Recover the Past#080.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#082.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#082.dst: 說不定 Caid 回心轉意了。你帶路去找他，我跟在你後面。
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#083.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at .
Recover the Past#083.dst: 到  說服 Caid 幫忙看守橋。

Recover the Past#084.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#085.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#085.dst: 是我們，我們有事想拜託你。這位我們共同的朋友想拉我去參加某種實驗。
Recover the Past#085.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#086.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#086.dst: 只是我一參加，{p} 就會無人防守。所以我們想問你願不願意在我抽不開身的時候，幫忙看著這邊。
Recover the Past#086.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#087.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#087.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#088.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
Recover the Past#088.dst: 別誤會，我寧可不要把 {p} 的安危交在一個賊……交在你這種人手上。你絕對不是我的第一人選，第二、第三也不是——
Recover the Past#088.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#091.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#091.dst: 你願意？這比我想的容易多了。記住——只要看到有任何襲擊的徵兆，立刻跑去那位博士的塔通知我們。打鬥的事交給專業的。
Recover the Past#091.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#092.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#092.dst: 我想都不會想別的！不過 Reynauld，你也想想，說不定過去被遺忘，是有它的理由的。
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#093.src: Well, that settles it. Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#093.dst: 好，那就這樣。我們快去找博士，我一分鐘都不想多把 {p} 的安危留在那個手腳不乾淨的人手上。
Recover the Past#093.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#094.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at .
Recover the Past#094.dst: 帶 Reynauld 到  的塔裡找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#095.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#095.dst: 我們快去找博士，我一分鐘都不想多把 {p} 的安危留在那個手腳不乾淨的人手上。
Recover the Past#095.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#097.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#097.dst: 啊，助手！歡迎回來，而且我看你把下一位受試者帶來了！太好了！
Recover the Past#097.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#099.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#099.dst: 好了好了，往前站。別害羞！就站到這邊來！直視那顆球，然後專心回想。
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#101.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#101.dst: 當然當然！別擔心，這個裝置已經在 Caid 身上做過大量測試了。很快的，我只要啟動這個……在這裡施個法……然後……
Recover the Past#101.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#103.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour
Recover the Past#103.dst: 啊——？欸，誰啊？這種時間敲什麼門——
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#105.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#106.src: N-no, of course not Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#106.dst: 不——不介意，當然不——呃。你要是，你知道的，先通知我一聲會比較好啊！
Recover the Past#106.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#107.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#107.dst: 你知道規矩不是這樣的。好了，東西呢？
Recover the Past#107.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#108.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never, oh, how was your week? Always just...
Recover the Past#108.dst: 是是……你這人永遠都是直接談正事。從來不會哦，這禮拜過得如何？永遠都只是……
Recover the Past#108.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#109.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#109.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#110.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#110.dst: 我從……呃，附近一家工廠弄了一些零件。我希望這是……這大概就是你要的。
Recover the Past#110.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#111.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#111.dst: ……嗯。你說是其中一家工廠？你確定你動手的時候沒被看到？要是我被人抓到跟一個有案底的罪犯講話，你知道我們兩個會有什麼下場。
Recover the Past#111.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#112.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#112.dst: 沒、沒有。我沒被看到。我，呃……有做防範。半夜進去的。你懂的。
Recover the Past#112.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#114.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you've asked for.
Recover the Past#114.dst: 那、那麼……這樣夠了嗎？你要的我都弄來了。
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#115.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#115.dst: 嗯……東西是弄來了沒錯。可是 Caid，你知道我每次出來跟你見面要冒多大的風險。光是最低限度，還不足以保證你的安全。
Recover the Past#115.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#116.src: I hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#116.dst: 我——哼。好、好，好啦，我——我再加一些綠寶石。讓這筆交易好看一點。
Recover the Past#116.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#117.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#117.dst: 很好。一如既往，合作愉快。我過幾週再來。
Recover the Past#117.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#119.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#119.dst: 啊，Reynauld。見到你真好。進來、進來。
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#120.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#120.dst: 請問這次召見是為了什麼，長官？
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#121.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#121.dst: 哦，沒什麼特別的。我只是想跟你稍微聊一下你的表現。
Recover the Past#121.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#122.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#122.dst: 你明白，我們這些在如此受敬重的職位上侍奉女王陛下的人，必須遵守一套……嚴格的榮譽準則，對吧？
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#123.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#123.dst: 否則，我們怎麼能確定自己的隊伍裡沒有任何不端？我們必須為這個偉大行省的人民立下榜樣。
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#124.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to...bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#124.dst: 那麼，你覺得，如果我們自己人裡面有誰……扭曲、或是打破了那套榮譽準則，會發生什麼事？那會開什麼樣的先例？
Recover the Past#124.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#126.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#126.dst: 我很遺憾地通知你，Reynauld，你將被剝奪軍階，並以不名譽及密謀對抗女王陛下的罪名遭到逮捕。
Recover the Past#126.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#127.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your own secrets.
Recover the Past#127.dst: 你的共犯，那個供貨的，前幾天被抓到了。我聽說他幾乎沒怎麼掙扎，就選擇把你的祕密全招了。
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#128.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#128.dst: 我們的隊伍裡容不下你了，Reynauld。走到這一步真是可惜。
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#129.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#129.dst: 助手！清醒點！還有得談呢。
Recover the Past#129.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#131.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#131.dst: 太精采了！助手，你到目前為止表現得非常好！我們比以往任何時候都更接近揭開 Fruma 的謎團！
Recover the Past#131.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#133.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#133.dst: {u}？！沒想到會在這麼遠的地方碰上你！
Recover the Past#133.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#134.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#134.dst: 寒暄的事晚點再說。Tasim？你怎麼會在這裡？Caid 呢？
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#135.src: The Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defenses. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#135.dst: 上將派我來加強 {p} 的防務。我本來以為會在橋邊見到你，結果只找到 Caid。
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#136.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#136.dst: 他說有一支部隊正在集結、要襲擊 {p}，還說你在這裡，然後他就跑掉了。
Recover the Past#136.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#137.src: That damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#137.dst: 那個該死的賊！我就知道我不該離開……這整件事都是個錯誤……可惡。
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#138.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go, Tasim and {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#138.dst: 現在沒時間浪費了。走吧，Tasim、{u}。我們得去救 {p}。
Recover the Past#138.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#139.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#139.dst: 那位 Tasim，他一定也是 Fruma 來的吧？既然是你的同伴，你應該把他也拉進我們這個小實驗。當然是為了科學！好了好了，快去。{p} 等著人救呢！
Recover the Past#139.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#140.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at .
Recover the Past#140.dst: 趕到  防守 {p}，擋下入侵。

Recover the Past#141.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#141.dst: 助手！你怎麼還在這裡？你的朋友們好像很需要你幫忙！
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#142.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#142.dst: 再說，這說不定正是把那位 Tasim 拉進我們實驗的好機會！嗯，沒錯，他絕對會是個有意思的觀察對象！
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#143.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#143.dst: 他們隨時會攻上這座橋。我們得做好準備。
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#145.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#145.dst: 回答得好，士兵。不管他們丟多少過來，我們都會把他們解決掉！
Recover the Past#145.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#146.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#146.dst: 你要做什麼就先去做，不過動作要快。敵人隨時可能到。
Recover the Past#146.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#147.dst: 抵禦腐化物對 {p} 的入侵！

Recover the Past#148.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#148.dst: Tasim，你顧前面，我在後方掩護。
Recover the Past#148.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#149.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#149.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#150.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#150.dst: 應該快了……要是 Aledar 也在就好了，那就跟以前一樣了。你不覺得嗎？
Recover the Past#150.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#151.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#151.dst: 我看到目標了！腐化部隊來襲！
Recover the Past#151.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#153.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#153.dst: 可惡。那個首領好像有護盾！我們要怎麼把牠打下來？
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#154.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#154.dst: 那些尖刺一定是牠的弱點！
Recover the Past#154.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#155.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#155.dst: 你說得對！Tasim、{u}。只要你們能把敵人擋在我外面，我就能瞄準那些尖刺開一記好的。那是我們唯一能解決這東西的機會。
Recover the Past#155.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#156.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#156.dst: ……啊。看來這會比預期的難一點。不過，我們全力以赴吧！
Recover the Past#156.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#157.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#157.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#158.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#158.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#159.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#159.dst: Reynauld！我們現在怎麼辦？這樣打不贏牠……
Recover the Past#159.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#160.src: I'm trying to think but... I've never...
Recover the Past#160.dst: 我正在想辦法，可是……我從來沒有……
Recover the Past#160.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#161.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#161.dst: Tasim、{u}，你們繼續擋住他們。我會想出辦法的，什麼辦法都好……
Recover the Past#161.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#162.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
Recover the Past#162.dst: 我們現在不能放棄，{p} 還在危險之中！
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#163.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#163.dst: Reynauld，這樣行不通！他們一直湧上來——我們……得換個做法，不然撐不住了！
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#164.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. Three men alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#164.dst: 你說得對。我們只能撤退，向 {p} 求援。三個人是打不贏這東西的！
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#165.dst: 可是，你們不是只有三個人！
Recover the Past#165.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#167.src: Caid, what are you doing here!? It's too dangerous, leave this one to the professionals!
Recover the Past#167.dst: Caid，你來這裡做什麼？！太危險了，這種事交給專業的！
Recover the Past#167.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#168.src: I'm done, I'm done letting my future slip out of my fingers!
Recover the Past#168.dst: 我受夠了，我受夠讓自己的未來從指縫間溜走！
Recover the Past#168.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#172.src: Now, Reynauld! Shoot! For goodness' sake, shoot! While it's distracted!
Recover the Past#172.dst: 就是現在，Reynauld！開槍！拜託你開槍啊！趁牠分心！
Recover the Past#172.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#173.src: It-It's coming down! Now's our chance!
Recover the Past#173.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#174.src: We did it... We really did it!
Recover the Past#174.dst: 我們做到了……我們真的做到了！
Recover the Past#174.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#178.src: Caid! You made it! You're a hero!
Recover the Past#178.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#179.src: That's all well and good but, what about your boat?
Recover the Past#179.dst: 那都很好，可是——你的船怎麼辦？
Recover the Past#179.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#180.src: I can always build another one, can't I?
Recover the Past#180.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#181.src: Ha. But not using my belongings this time.
Recover the Past#181.dst: 哈。不過這次別再拿我的東西了。
Recover the Past#181.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#182.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough, considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case. Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#182.dst: 好了，考慮到剛才的狀況，Caid 看起來還算沒事。我帶他去檢查一下，以防萬一。謝謝你們幫忙，Tasim、{u}。還有 Caid 也是……
Recover the Past#182.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#183.src: You must be wanting to take Tasim with you for your experiment. After all you've done today, I can hardly object. But, Tasim...
Recover the Past#183.dst: 你大概是想把 Tasim 也帶去做那個實驗吧。今天你做了這麼多，我實在不好反對。不過，Tasim……
Recover the Past#183.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#184.src: Think carefully before looking into that crystal. For some, the past is filled with things they'd rather forget.
Recover the Past#184.dst: 看那顆水晶之前，好好想清楚。對某些人來說，過去裝的都是他們寧可忘掉的東西。
Recover the Past#184.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#185.src: Recovering memories from Fruma, huh... That's definitely something I'd be interested in. I've had a strange feeling about it, ever since we first realized we lost them.
Recover the Past#185.dst: 復原在 Fruma 的記憶啊……那確實是我會感興趣的事。從我們第一次發現記憶不見的時候，我心裡就一直怪怪的。
Recover the Past#185.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#186.src: You were there, remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#186.dst: 你當時也在場，記得吧？我們才剛踏進 Wynn，然後……Aledar 也跟我們在一起，他第一天差點就死了！但願他在外頭有小心一點……
Recover the Past#186.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#187.src: Ah, anyway. Please, lead the way to the doctor. I'm intrigued to see what it's all about.
Recover the Past#187.dst: 啊，總之。請帶路去博士那裡吧。我很想知道那到底是怎麼回事。
Recover the Past#187.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#188.src: Bring Tasim to Dr. Picard in his tower at .
Recover the Past#188.dst: 帶 Tasim 到  的塔裡找 Picard 博士。

Recover the Past#190.src: ... Oh, {u}, you're back with yet another subject I see! Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb.
Recover the Past#190.dst: ……哦，{u}，你又帶了一位受試者回來！太好了、太好了。來，請站到球前面。
Recover the Past#190.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#191.src: So, doctor. You're certain this is safe? Reynauld warned me that
Recover the Past#191.dst: 那麼，博士。您確定這安全嗎？Reynauld 警告過我說——
Recover the Past#191.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#192.src: Oh, yes, yes. We've tested it with two subjects before, haven't we, {u}? Besides, I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#192.dst: 哦，當然當然。我們之前已經在兩位受試者身上測試過了，對吧，{u}？再說，我算過了！數字全都沒問題！
Recover the Past#192.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#193.src: There's only the tiniest bit of instability. Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then
Recover the Past#193.dst: 只有極其微小的一點不穩定。哼。也許它只是需要更多功率……只要我把灌進法術的魔力再提高，那麼——
Recover the Past#193.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#194.src: Hold on. You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?
Recover the Past#194.dst: 等一下。它已經不穩定了，你還想再灌更多魔法進去？
Recover the Past#194.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#195.src: Don't you want to know what your life was like before? Even if it's not what you want to see, isn't it better to know?
Recover the Past#195.dst: 難道你不想知道自己以前的人生是什麼樣子嗎？就算那不是你想看到的，知道總比不知道好吧？
Recover the Past#195.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#196.src: Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but I'll do it.
Recover the Past#196.dst: 好吧。可以看我的記憶。我不確定我真的同意這個說法……但我做。
Recover the Past#196.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#197.src: Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
Recover the Past#197.dst: 太好了，聽到這句話我真高興！那麼。三……二……一……啟動！
Recover the Past#197.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#198.src: All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
Recover the Past#198.dst: 全員就位！逮捕那個叛亂分子！
Recover the Past#198.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#200.src: Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
Recover the Past#200.dst: 嘖……他跑不遠。你們所有人，搜遍整座城！每個角落都不許放過！別讓他跑了！
Recover the Past#200.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#201.src: I- oh, this is bad... What can I...
Recover the Past#201.dst: 我——哦，這下糟了……我能怎麼……
Recover the Past#201.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#202.src: ...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's...
Recover the Past#202.dst: ……該死。全都該死。我不能就這樣看著一個人流血流到死，就算他是……
Recover the Past#202.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#204.src: It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
Recover the Past#204.dst: 沒事的，你會沒事的……我知道該怎麼做，就算我其實不該做……
Recover the Past#204.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#205.src: G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get
Recover the Past#205.dst: 啊——！我、我在哪裡？你是誰？我得走——

Recover the Past#207.src: He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
Recover the Past#207.dst: 他在這裡！而且他有同夥！兩個都抓起來！
Recover the Past#207.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#208.src: My magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#208.dst: 我的魔法快抓不住了……但顯然還有東西可以看！提高功率——
Recover the Past#208.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#209.src: So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
Recover the Past#209.dst: 所以呢？我當時就該讓你在我家裡流血流到死？別說傻話了。
Recover the Past#209.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#210.src: Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
Recover the Past#210.dst: 對！你就該！因為現在，我不只因為對王室犯罪被捕，連你也被揪出來是受詛者之一。你當初要是……袖手旁觀，這一切都不會發生。
Recover the Past#210.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#211.src: ...It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#211.dst: ……那是對的事。我有能力幫忙的時候，沒辦法袖手旁觀。
Recover the Past#211.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#212.src: Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
Recover the Past#212.dst: 是啊，結果對我們幫助可大了。你知道沒有人能從這裡出去吧？他們一旦把你帶走，就再也沒人聽過你的消息！所以，我們現在就是這個處境。
Recover the Past#212.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#214.src: Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Recover the Past#214.speaker: Royal Guard

Recover the Past#215.src: Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
Recover the Past#215.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#216.src: See you on the other side, Aledar.
Recover the Past#216.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#217.src: Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
Recover the Past#217.dst: 咳咳。程序準備好了。啟動調律器。
Recover the Past#217.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#218.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to
Recover the Past#218.dst: 那——那是什麼？你們要對我做什——
Recover the Past#218.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#219.src: Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
Recover the Past#219.dst: 安靜。在我們開始之前，我要把一件事講清楚。Fruma 不需要你們這種人。Fruma 不想要你們這種人。
Recover the Past#219.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#220.src: What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
Recover the Past#220.dst: 我們今天對你所做的，是一份仁慈、一份寬容。若讓這個世界照它的方式來，你的下場會慘得多。接下來的過程中，請記住這一點。
Recover the Past#220.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#222.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents would be useful.
Recover the Past#222.dst: 你是一名新兵，即將被派往 Wynn 行省，為他們的戰爭作戰。你之所以入伍，是因為你認為自己獨特的……才能會派上用場。
Recover the Past#222.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#223.src: Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Recover the Past#223.dst: Fruma 在你的過去裡不過是一個小點。一件已成定局的事實，細節都遺落在假設性的過去裡。你對它懷有好感，卻什麼都記不得。
Recover the Past#223.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#224.src: You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
Recover the Past#224.dst: 你會為他們的戰爭作戰。你會為它而活，為它而死。你將永遠屬於 Wynn，而 Fruma 會很樂意擺脫你。
Recover the Past#224.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#227.src: Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
Recover the Past#227.dst: 要我再說一次嗎？你明白了嗎？
Recover the Past#227.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#228.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
Recover the Past#228.dst: 我再問一次。你的指令，明白了嗎？
Recover the Past#228.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#230.src: Wonderful. Take this one to the caravan. It looks like we'll be able to fit in two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#230.dst: 很好。把這個帶去馬車隊。看來今天這一批還塞得下兩個。
Recover the Past#230.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#235.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
Recover the Past#235.dst: 助手！清醒過來！你陷得太深了，那段記憶正在把你吸進去！
Recover the Past#235.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#236.src: Good grief there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
Recover the Past#236.dst: 天啊——你總算回來了！你知道剛才有多危險嗎？！
Recover the Past#236.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#237.src: What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
Recover the Past#237.dst: 你以為我的助手要是永遠被困在自己的記憶裡，我會有什麼下場？沒好事！
Recover the Past#237.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#238.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! Come on, come over here, we have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#238.dst: ……好啦，好啦。那確實給了我們更多資訊。不過別再這樣了！來，過來這邊，我們有很多要談的。
Recover the Past#238.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#239.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#239.dst: ……哼。我承認，我……我不確定該拿這些資訊怎麼辦。
Recover the Past#239.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#240.src: The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
Recover the Past#240.dst: 以單次使用來說，記憶復原化球的表現已經達到我能期待的水準了……可是老天，那看起來實在讓人難受。
Recover the Past#240.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#241.src: It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
Recover the Past#241.dst: 照理說，Caid 和 Reynauld 也經歷過同樣的事……而我的魔法穿不透那道牆……
Recover the Past#241.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#242.src: Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
Recover the Past#242.dst: 這就是他們在外面、在 Fruma 對待罪犯的方式嗎？把他們丟出來替 Wynn 打仗？
Recover the Past#242.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#243.src: ... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
Recover the Past#243.dst: ……我得想想自己還要往記憶裡挖多深。總之！這件事一開始，我答應過讓你看你自己的記憶。
Recover the Past#243.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#244.src: The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
Recover the Past#244.dst: 那個承諾依然算數，你想要的話。就像其他人那樣站到球前面就行了。
Recover the Past#244.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#245.src: Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
Recover the Past#245.dst: 怎麼樣？那個承諾依然算數，你想要的話。就像其他人那樣站到球前面。
Recover the Past#245.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#246.src: H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
Recover the Past#246.dst: 啊——？！那顆球！我那顆美麗的記憶復原化球！它毀了！
Recover the Past#246.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#247.src: ... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
Recover the Past#247.dst: ……哦，算了。設計圖我還存在這附近某個地方。再做一顆就是了……不過還是很心痛。
Recover the Past#247.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#249.src: Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
Recover the Past#249.dst: 哦！哦對！抱歉，我完全忘了關心你！你還好嗎？
Recover the Past#249.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#250.src: None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
Recover the Past#250.dst: 其他受試者都沒有出現這麼強烈的反應……奇怪。這幾乎像是我們讀取到了本來不存在的記憶。
Recover the Past#250.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#251.src: ... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
Recover the Past#251.dst: ……嗯。咳咳。總之，我得繼續我的研究。我確信還有更多可以學的……
Recover the Past#251.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#252.src: As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
Recover the Past#252.dst: 這是謝謝你幫忙的酬謝。來，收下。啊，還有……我想你的朋友就在塔外面。你或許該去看看他。
Recover the Past#252.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#253.src: Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at .
Recover the Past#253.dst: 到 Picard 博士的塔外找 Tasim。

Recover the Past#255.src: Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
Recover the Past#255.dst: 受詛的。他說我是受詛的。那對我來說代表什麼……？
Recover the Past#255.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#256.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#256.dst: 還有那個審訊官……我不知道該怎麼想。我們所有人——我們抵達 Wynn 時以為自己知道的那些事……沒有一件是真的。
Recover the Past#256.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#257.src: ...Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
Recover the Past#257.dst: ……我們兩個真的只是憑純粹的偶然遇上的嗎？他當時在逃，然後……直接摔進了我的人生。
Recover the Past#257.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#258.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#258.dst: 我——我需要一點空間想一想。需要……沉澱。你可以……拜託你別把這些事告訴 Aledar。
Recover the Past#258.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#259.src: He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's he's better off not knowing.
Recover the Past#259.dst: 他不需要知道這一切。他——他不知道比較好。
Recover the Past#259.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#260.src: ... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across from the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
Recover the Past#260.dst: ……我想我會前往 Gavel 行省。它在海的另一邊，離……離這一切夠遠。
Recover the Past#260.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#261.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#261.dst: 等你變強了，你也該去那裡看看。說不定我們總有一天會再遇上。
Recover the Past#261.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#262.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#262.dst: 那麼，就先在這裡道別了。不是永別——只是暫時。我們有緣再見，{u}。
Recover the Past#262.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#263.src: ... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
Recover the Past#263.dst: ……我只是在這裡歇一下。我很快就會上路。
Recover the Past#263.speaker: Tasim
